items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I can't remember all that, Nina, because I used to pedal on a wagon

ctx.x: That's Tulane Street. That's Orpharet Street.

Yeah. Way up Orpharet. Way up, way up, yeah, yeah, yeah. I can't remember all that, Nina, because I used to pedal on a wagon, you know what I mean? And I go all around, but right now, the way they didn't disfigure them streets and things, man, it's hard. You don't know where you at. Yeah.
